title: Terrestrial origin of viviparity in Mesozoic marine reptiles indicated by Early Triassic embryonic fossils
authors: Motani, R.; Jiang, D.-Y.; Tintori, A.; Rieppel, O.; Chen, G.-B.
note: Specimen AGM I-1 is the maternal specimen; the paper distinguishes two embryos and one neonate and uses orientation and phylogeny to infer broader reproductive history.

title: Soft-tissue evidence for homeothermy and crypsis in a Jurassic ichthyosaur
authors: Lindgren, J.; Sjövall, P.; Carney, R.M.; et al.
note: The focal specimen is MH 432 from the Posidonia Shale and is housed at the Urweltmuseum Hauff, Holzmaden.

title: A Triassic plesiosaurian skeleton and bone histology inform on evolution of a unique body plan
authors: Wintrich, T.; Hayashi, S.; Houssaye, A.; Nakajima, Y.; Sander, P.M.
note: Holotype LWL-MFN P 64047 is linked to Exter Formation locality and bed information, anatomy, histology and supplementary phylogenetic matrices.

title: Viviparity and K-selected life history in a Mesozoic marine plesiosaur (Reptilia, Sauropterygia)
note: Adult and fetal material share catalogue number LACM 129639; viviparity is specimen evidence, whereas K-selection and social implications are comparative interpretations.

title: The four-flipper swimming method of plesiosaurs enabled efficient and effective locomotion
authors: Muscutt, L.E.; Dyke, G.; Weymouth, G.D.; Naish, D.; Palmer, C.; Ganapathisubramani, B.
publisher: Proceedings of the Royal Society B
note: The study is a recirculating-water-channel experiment with prescribed flipper models; supplementary data are archived at DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.c.3846208.

title: Pterosaur melanosomes support signalling functions for early feathers
authors: Cincotta, A.; Nicolaï, M.; Campos, H.B.N.; et al.
note: The focal Crato Formation specimen MCT.R.1884 is preserved on five slabs; melanosome geometry and feather homology are separated from exact-colour claims.

title: Egg accumulation with 3D embryos provides insight into the life history of a pterosaur
authors: Wang, X.; Kellner, A.W.A.; Jiang, S.; et al.
note: The paper reports 215 exposed eggs in a 3.28-square-metre block, up to about 300 in that block, and 16 embryo-bearing eggs; behavioural and hatchling-flight claims are treated as interpretations.

title: On the size and flight diversity of giant pterosaurs, the use of birds as pterosaur analogues and comments on pterosaur flightlessness
note: This is a comparative scaling and biomechanical feasibility study; reconstructed mass, planform, muscle power and launch kinematics are model inputs rather than direct observations.

title: Bobosaurus forojuliensis, a new sauropterygian (Reptilia) from the Upper Triassic (lower Carnian) of northeastern Italy
publisher: Rivista Italiana di Paleontologia e Stratigrafia
note: Holotype MFSN 27285 from the Rio del Lago Formation combines nothosaurian and plesiosaurian features; affinity near Plesiosauria is explicitly uncertain.

title: Two new species of Ichthyosaurus from the lowermost Jurassic (Hettangian) of Somerset, England
note: Hettangian Somerset specimens support species diagnoses and phylogenetic testing within Ichthyosaurus; the interval is regional and not a genus-wide global range.

title: Anatomy and systematics of the pterosaur Carniadactylus gen. n. rosenfeldi (Dalla Vecchia, 1995)
publisher: Rivista Italiana di Paleontologia e Stratigrafia
note: Detailed redescription and phylogenetic analysis of Norian pterosaur holotype MFSN 1797 and referred specimen MPUM 6009; their horizon does not establish a global pterosaur first appearance.
